compliance_decision:
1. Accountable institutions must ensure that records are readily available to the Centre and relevant supervisory body when required, can be reproduced in a legible format, include reference numbers or details of issuers, and if stored off-site provide third party storage details.
2. Revised Guidance Note 7A – Implementation of various aspects of the FIC Act (Financial Institutions Code).
3. The context specifies that records must be accessible to competent authorities for supervision purposes; they should also include identifiable information and, if stored off-site, details about third-party storage facilities are required as per section 170 of the Revised Guidance Note which outlines principles for record keeping.
4. Yes
